Messages.Author: The Horror
Messages.Body:
Is mirror image at superior considered to be an action modifier similarly to
form of mist? That is, can it be played multiple times over the course of
resolving the action (minion A blocks, minion B plays mirror image, minion B
is blocked and plays mirror image again, and again, and again, etc).

Thalles

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:

>Is mirror image at superior considered to be an action modifier similarly to

In the absence of any card text or errata suggesting such behavior, no.
Simply reading the card should suffice to convey an adequate understanding
of its mechanics.
